# Q3 Enterprise Pricing Teardown

**Prepared by:** Revenue Operations
**Quarter:** Q3 2026
**Contract template:** MSA-2026-C
**Classification:** Internal — Confidential (Sales leadership)

## List pricing

| Tier | Annual base |
| --- | --- |
| Team | $4,200 |
| Business | $9,700 |
| **Enterprise** | **$18,500** |

Enterprise base includes 100 seats. Additional seats are $63 per seat per year
beyond the included allocation.

## Volume discounts

| Seats | Discount off base |
| --- | --- |
| 100–249 | 0% |
| **250–499** | **14%** |
| 500–999 | 22% |
| 1,000+ | Bespoke, requires VP Revenue approval |

## Approval floors

The **floor price is $12,900** for an Enterprise annual contract. Any proposed
price below $12,900 requires written approval from the VP of Revenue before the
quote is issued. Deals at or above the floor may be closed by the account
executive.

Multi-year commitments may apply an additional 6% per year beyond year one,
compounding, without further approval.

## Non-standard terms requiring legal review

- Payment terms beyond net 45
- Any uncapped liability clause
- Customer-supplied MSA in place of MSA-2026-C
- Data residency commitments outside the contracted region

## Competitive notes

Win rate against the incumbent was **38%** in Q3, up from 31% in Q2. The most
frequently cited loss reason remains onboarding timeline, not price.
